description: Built early 1983, delivered Dec 1983, damaged on ground 17 May 2005, trucked to Ezhimala 2008. Mounted near the main parade ground, ejection seat removed. Source WoI 2017.
Displayed wings folded at a road corner in the academy; previously briefly on museum ship Vikrant. Source WoI 2017.
Ka-25 on display at the academy, identity not recorded. Source WoI 2017.
Sea King marked 01 near the parade grounds, identity not recorded. Source WoI 2017.
